scene: The tipped robot bows, projecting transit tokens onto the counter.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view in the noodle bar. On the far left, the chrome robot bows deeply behind the counter. The broad-shouldered Pacific Islander man stands centre in his floral shirt, top knot, and ukulele. Along the glossy counter sit three glowing holographic departure tokens: green solar-sail left, red dragon train centre, blue cable pod right.
shown: a green solar-sail junk token gleaming on the counter left
